tavern.name: The Rusty Flagon
tavern.description: A dimly lit tavern with creaky floorboards and old oak beams. Rain taps the shutters while a fire pops in the stone hearth.

hallway.name: Stone Hallway
hallway.description: A narrow corridor lined with faded banners and cracked sconces. Footsteps echo along the damp stone.

armory.name: Old Armory
armory.description: Weapon racks lean at odd angles and rusted armor stands in silent rows.

cellar_stairs.name: Cellar Stairway
cellar_stairs.description: A tight spiral staircase disappears into cool darkness below.

cellar.name: Wine Cellar
cellar.description: Dusty barrels crowd the room, and pooled water reflects weak torchlight.

courtyard.name: Castle Courtyard
courtyard.description: Overgrown flagstones surround a dry fountain etched with faded constellations.

gatehouse.name: Broken Gatehouse
gatehouse.description: Collapsed battlements frame the courtyard entrance, and cold wind whistles through shattered crenellations.

chapel.name: Ashen Chapel
chapel.description: Soot-stained pews face a broken altar where candlelight still burns against the gloom.

library.name: Sable Library
library.description: Tall shelves tower over reading desks, and loose pages murmur in drafts from unseen vents.

observatory.name: Starfall Observatory
observatory.description: A cracked dome reveals the sky. Brass instruments point at stars painted across the night.

alchemy_lab.name: Alchemical Laboratory
alchemy_lab.description: Copper pipes hiss over cracked benches where reagents still bubble in glass coils.

rune_hall.name: Hall of Runes
rune_hall.description: Glowing sigils pulse across the walls and floor, humming with restrained arcane power.

mirror_sanctum.name: Mirror Sanctum
mirror_sanctum.description: A circular chamber of black glass mirrors reflects impossible angles and distant candlelight.

cistern.name: Sunken Cistern
cistern.description: Water drips from vaulted stone, and submerged carvings hint at an older ruin beneath the castle.

crypt_antechamber.name: Crypt Antechamber
crypt_antechamber.description: Crumbled sarcophagi flank a bronze floodgate engraved with warnings in two dead tongues.

ancient_vault.name: Ancient Vault
ancient_vault.description: A sealed treasury filled with relics, stone tablets, and a ledger of forgotten dynasties.

rusty_key.name: Rusty Key
rusty_key.description: A heavy iron key covered in rust.

torch.name: Wooden Torch
torch.description: A simple torch wrapped in old pitch cloth.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: A battered but balanced sword with a chipped crossguard.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: A round shield reinforced with cracked iron bands.

health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A small vial of red tonic that smells of mint and copper.

old_map.name: Faded Map
old_map.description: A worn map showing the old fortress and buried waterworks.

bandage.name: Linen Bandage
bandage.description: Clean linen strips bundled with a bronze pin.

rope.name: Coiled Rope
rope.description: A sturdy hemp rope with knots every arm's length.

obsidian_dagger.name: Obsidian Dagger
obsidian_dagger.description: A black volcanic blade with a wrapped leather grip.

lantern.name: Brass Lantern
lantern.description: A hinged brass lantern with a smoky glass pane.

crowbar.name: Iron Crowbar
crowbar.description: A bent iron pry bar, useful for forcing old boards.

silver_chalice.name: Silver Chalice
silver_chalice.description: A ritual cup engraved with stars and wave motifs.

chapel_seal.name: Chapel Seal
chapel_seal.description: A wax-and-bronze seal bearing the castle crest.

stained_note.name: Stained Note
stained_note.description: A note hinting that moonlight reveals the true rune sequence.

scholar_quill.name: Scholar's Quill
scholar_quill.description: A raven-feather quill balanced for neat script.

rune_tablet.name: Rune Tablet
rune_tablet.description: A stone tablet showing four glyphs and a mirrored fifth mark.

moon_dial.name: Moon Dial
moon_dial.description: A brass disk that aligns with lunar phases and etched runes.

astral_lens.name: Astral Lens
astral_lens.description: A crystal lens that refracts light into thin spectral lines.

alchemy_reagent.name: Volatile Reagent
alchemy_reagent.description: A corked flask of bright blue alchemical concentrate.

etched_rune_key.name: Etched Rune Key
etched_rune_key.description: A bronze key etched with the same glyphs found in the library tablet.

floodgate_crank.name: Floodgate Crank
floodgate_crank.description: A removable valve crank sized to fit old ruin machinery.

cistern_valve.name: Cistern Valve
cistern_valve.description: A corroded wheel-valve that still turns with effort.

mirror_shard.name: Mirror Shard
mirror_shard.description: A sharp shard of enchanted mirror that reflects scenes not in front of you.

vault_ledger.name: Vault Ledger
vault_ledger.description: A heavy ledger documenting relic transfers and hidden chamber payments.

barkeep.name: Greta the Barkeep
barkeep.description: A stout woman with kind eyes and an excellent memory for faces.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
giant_rat.description: A cellar rat as large as a hound, always watching from the dark.

wandering_merchant.name: Elric the Merchant
wandering_merchant.description: A road-worn trader who always seems to carry exactly what people need.

apprentice_librarian.name: Mira the Apprentice
apprentice_librarian.description: A focused young librarian cataloging damaged tomes and rune fragments.

chapel_caretaker.name: Brother Alden
chapel_caretaker.description: An elderly caretaker who keeps the chapel lit and offers practical advice.

astronomer_lyra.name: Lyra the Astronomer
astronomer_lyra.description: A calm scholar studying how starlight reacts to ancient runes.

ruins_guide.name: Tovan the Guide
ruins_guide.description: A patient ruins guide who knows which stones are stable and which are traps.

arcane_sentinel.name: Arcane Sentinel
arcane_sentinel.description: A floating construct that guards rune chambers with suspicious intelligence.
